description: This file defines functions and types for chunking and splitting Discord messages, especially handling fenced code blocks and line/character limits, with special handling for italics formatting.

classes.name: OpenFence
classes.description: Represents a fenced code block's opening line details, including indentation, marker character, length, and the original line.

methods.name: countLines
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a given text.

methods.name: parseFenceLine
methods.description: Parses a line to determine if it is a fenced code block opening line and returns its details.

methods.name: closeFenceLine
methods.description: Generates a closing fence line based on an OpenFence object.

methods.name: closeFenceIfNeeded
methods.description: Appends a closing fence line to the text if an open fence is present.

methods.name: splitLongLine
methods.description: Splits a long line into multiple segments respecting max character limit and whitespace preservation.

methods.name: chunkDiscordText
methods.description: Chunks Discord message text into parts respecting max character and line limits, maintaining fenced code block balance.

methods.name: chunkDiscordTextWithMode
methods.description: Chunks Discord message text with support for different chunking modes, including line-based chunking.

methods.name: rebalanceReasoningItalics
methods.description: Adjusts chunks to properly open and close italics formatting for reasoning payloads starting with 'Reasoning:\n_' and ending with '_'.
